…and to the right of the center is black
Counter-clockwise: at u_time = 0.5, up-and-right of the center is white

predict.question: Spinning at 1 radian per second, how many seconds does **one full turn** take?
predict.explain: **About 6.28 seconds.** A full turn is 2π radians, not 360: GLSL's sin, cos and rotations all work in radians.
